vol intel (data/vol/intel.json).why_allowance: MEASURED, not guessed. This bake's asof is the newest day carrying BOTH a NIFTY 50 TR level and an India VIX print, so its allowance is the arithmetic of that JOINT calendar. Measured 2026-09-04 on the bake's own date list: the largest gap between consecutive joint days over the last 3 years is 4 calendar days (732 gaps: 549x1d, 27x2d, 133x3d, 23x4d, none longer), which is what a Thursday close read on the following Monday looks like. Add 1 day because a single missing Yahoo ^INDIAVIX print pushes the joint date back one further trading day (49 such days since 2008, longest run 1 day, in 2008), and 1 day of slack so a boundary case does not cry wolf every long weekend: 4 + 1 + 1 = 6. The full-history max joint gap is 6 days (12 occurrences, all pre-2023 holiday calendars), so 6 also covers the worst day this feed has ever had.
